title: REQ · BootScene releases the playAnimation subscription on shutdown
summary: Shutdown unsubscribes from playAnimation so later events do nothing
description: Context: the SHUTDOWN handler in create() (L73-L83) releases keyboard, store, effects and objects. Desired behavior: the playAnimation unsubscribe function returned by reactToPhaser.on is also called there, so a stopped scene never touches destroyed sprites.
acceptance_criteria: Given the SHUTDOWN callback has run, when playAnimation is emitted, then sprite.play is not called
Given the scene is running, when SHUTDOWN has not run, then the handler count on playAnimation is one
technical_constraints: Use the unsubscribe function returned by reactToPhaser.on
definition_of_done: Unsubscribe stored and called on shutdown
